summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 3D power grid visualization app. All features working perfectly - dark theme, 3D rendering, interactive controls, and UI panels all functional.
passed_tests: Page loads without errors with dark charcoal background
3D scene renders properly with slanted camera angle (~50°)
Dark theme implemented correctly with good text contrast
Node Health panel shows all 9 nodes with status dots and load percentages
Grid Metrics panel displays GRID LOAD, VOLTAGE, STABILITY, EFFICIENCY bars
AI Decision Log panel shows initialization messages
All 5 control buttons present and functional (Trigger Overload, Line Failure, Voltage Drop, Heal Grid, Reset)
Bottom bar displays all stats (NODES 9/9, LINES 10/10, PREDICTED 0, AUTO-HEALS 0, UPTIME)
Legend shows all 6 status types with proper color coding
Status badge shows NOMINAL initially in green
Trigger Overload button changes status to WARNING and adds log entries
Reset button restores system to NOMINAL state
3D buildings visible from proper slanted perspective
Particle effects and power line animations functional
